Enum Class PalisadeSprite

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<PalisadeSprite>
fr.ubordeaux.ao.mazing.view.sprite.PalisadeSprite
All Implemented Interfaces:
fr.ubordeaux.ao.mazing.view.shadow.ShadowGeometryProvider, Sprite, Serializable, Comparable<PalisadeSprite>, Constable
public enum PalisadeSprite extends Enum<PalisadeSprite> implements Sprite, fr.ubordeaux.ao.mazing.view.shadow.ShadowGeometryProvider
A wooden palisade aligned with one edge of a diamond-shaped floor tile. No dedicated fence texture is present in the original isometric atlas, so these four reusable sprites are drawn once and cached as images.

    • isInFrontOf

      public boolean isInFrontOf(double tileX, double tileY, double actorX, double actorY)
      Tests which side of this fence the actor occupies in grid coordinates. An X-facing edge is a plane of constant X; a Y-facing edge has constant Y. Comparing screen Y or the tile center would incorrectly classify the far-side fence as foreground on an isometric platform.
      Parameters:
      tileX - grid X of the tile carrying this edge
      tileY - grid Y of the tile carrying this edge
      actorX - precise grid X of the actor's feet
      actorY - precise grid Y of the actor's feet
      Returns:
      true when the fence lies between the viewer and the actor
